t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in specific pairs. Each individual within a pairing leads to either a dark or a light forest. One will give you more mushrooms than the other. Learning which individual gnomes within pairs lead to which forest type is critical for receiving the largest quantity of mushrooms possible. The number of mushrooms given per specific gnome will change over the course of the experiment.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes will appear in pairs with different colours. Each colour of gnome will lead to a different forest, either light or dark. The gnomes that lead to the dark forest are the following: brown, pink, yellow, and purple. The gnomes that lead to the light forest are the following: red, green, orange, and blue. The number of mushrooms found in either the dark or light forests will vary per round and change quickly. Utilize the turns featuring the 1x multiplier to gauge which forest (light or dark) currently has the larger quantity of mushrooms. If noticing you receive more mushrooms in a given forest type, make sure to choose corresponding gnomes for that forest type during the 5x rounds to maximize your points.
